failure_summary.description: Calls omitted or misrepresented requested values, qualifiers, or documented parameter choices despite the relevant schema being available.
Agents selected a same-topic endpoint that did not provide the requested operation, or failed to include a requested endpoint.

patch.reasoning: The clearest repeated, actionable gap is confusing schema field names with populated arguments or otherwise failing to put requested values into argument entries. The skill already covers endpoint choice and qualifier mapping, so the patch makes the final argument-serialization check more concrete without repeating those rules.

edits.content: - Treat the tool schema as a list of argument definitions, not as the arguments themselves: each argument you provide must include its exact field name and actual value in the active answer contract. Never emit bare field names or an empty argument list when the query supplies a value. Before submitting, verify that every explicit input appears in a value field, using the documented canonical form where required.
